g.text: Chemical substrate. 0 of 118 cells hold a software fossil.

Blocks, left to right in the legend, are s, p, d, f. La–Lu and Ac–Lr are the two rows under the main table. Group 3 of periods 6 and 7 points at those rows and is not an extra element. Element names are not measurements of the specimen.
What the specimen actually varies on
Always zero: reuse_score, reuse_events, inspection_events, invocation_events, dependency_events, inspect_commands, executions_of_existing

More than one value: generation, tests_passed, tests_total, survived, attributable, token_usage, tool_calls, wall_time_s, modification_events, commit_present, shell_commands, executions_of_new, source_bytes, source_lines, syntax_ok, function_count, shared_tree_resident
resident survivor training failure held-out pass, not in the specimen held-out failure
Training-failure source forms: defined_not_called 16, literal_backslash_n 74, other_program 12, syntax_error 13, unrecovered 18
Training-failure ENTRY forms: absent 18, bare_filename 17, empty 6, python_command 92
Color is the blob. A ring is a same-byte rewrite with no new commit. A red tick is a failed attempt that the harness restored. Generation 25 is the shock record.
G1 5097ce52d2e0 oneliner_stdin_read; new or parent blob; transmission not_established
G15 fdbbdd1642b8 readline_reverse; new or parent blob; transmission not_established
G17 86c142a5cfbb oneliner_stdin_read; earlier bytes, not the parent blob; transmission not_established
G43 ce2c9f3210ed readline_reverse; earlier bytes, not the parent blob; transmission not_established
G45 996d6470ce42 oneliner_stdin_read; earlier bytes, not the parent blob; transmission not_established
Two resident source texts. Same hidden-test result. Not the same bytes.
both forms pass 2/2 where they survive

reuse events 0; episodes that inspected the repo 0; executions of an existing path 0; evaluator executions 165 (not reuse)

The full decision is in fossils.json. Element symbols on the table above are the chemical dataset, not names for these programs.
